name: crew-board
description: Crew board: running worktrees, To test count, open tickets, last release, where the time goes; guards crew launches

tracker.title: Ticket tracker
tracker.description: Tracker file, relative to the repo root: numbered `N. **Title** … workflow: x` entries and a To test section

toTestHeading.title: To test heading
toTestHeading.description: Heading of the tracker section whose `- ` lines a person still has to check

maxSlots.title: Slot limit
maxSlots.description: Most active worktrees under .claude/worktrees at once; a crew launch past it is refused

activeHours.title: Active window (hours)
activeHours.description: A worktree whose HEAD moved within this many hours is active and takes a slot; older ones are idle and only counted

toTestLimit.title: Play-check limit
toTestLimit.description: Above this many To test lines the board warns that the owner names every start

startWords.title: Start words
startWords.description: Regex alternatives (case-insensitive, whole words) the owner's latest message must hold for a crew launch

guardAgent.title: Guarded agent type
guardAgent.description: An Agent subagent_type launched only in a start turn too (the fast-lane implementer); empty guards none

releaseGrep.title: Release commit pattern
releaseGrep.description: Extended regex for the subject of the last release commit

shellKinds.title: Extra shell kinds
shellKinds.description: `label=regex` pairs separated by `;`, checked before the built-in tests / build + lint / landing + git kinds
